datasheet.title: PDU08C13H data sheet (1U 19 inch 8 Port Rack Mount PDU, IEC C13)

description: StarTech.com PDU08C13H, a 1U horizontal basic rack PDU with eight IEC C13 outlets, single phase. It takes 16 A at 120 V or 20 A at 240 V. It has 3600 J surge protection and a resettable circuit breaker. A black steel box with a mounting bracket at each end. The front carries the eight C13 outlets in a row from the left and two round push buttons. At the right is an IEC C20 power inlet. The 10 ft C19 to NEMA 5-20P cord in the box is not part of the unit and is not drawn. No document shows the rear.

gaps.note: no document shows the rear of this model: the data sheet has one photograph, of the front, and the manual is not held. All eight outlets and the inlet stand on the front in the photograph, so nothing is known to stand on the rear.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the rear, or the instruction manual.

gaps.note: the outlets are drawn turned 270, as `cyberpower/pdu30bhvt8r` turns its C13 outlets, and the C20 inlet is placed with no turn (the library's part as it is). No other device is cited for the inlet. The photograph is too small to show which way each receptacle's earth pin points, so both turns are estimates.
gaps.wanted: a larger photograph of the front, or the instruction manual.

gaps.note: the photograph shows two round chrome push buttons between the outlets and the inlet and no label is legible. The data sheet names one "built-in resettable circuit breaker". Whether the two buttons are two breakers, or one breaker and one other control, is not stated.
the data sheet gives no ear, bracket or hole dimension; it lists four M5 screws and four M5 cage nuts. The body width between the folds is an estimate.
the photograph sees the top, with a printed rating label, and the right end at a steep angle; nothing of either can be measured.

The photograph shows two round chrome push buttons between the outlets and the inlet; they are drawn with common/breaker-push-reset@1 on that reading (gaps: breaker-buttons).

chassis.note: datasheet - PDU08C13H data sheet, page 2: "Product Length 19.1 in [48.4 cm]", "Product Width 3.9 in [98.8 mm]", "Product Height 1.7 in [44.0 mm]", "Weight of Product 3.4 lb [1.5 kg]", "Color Black", "Material Steel", "Form Factor Horizontal". The length includes the brackets; the body between the folds is taken as 440 mm, the figure the 8NS8-RACK-MOUNT-PDU guide's diagram gives for the same maker's 1U strip (ESTIMATED for this model). The width is read as the depth of a horizontal unit.

front.note: estimated - millimetres from the body's left edge and its top, read off the photograph (see method). Outlet centres 17.7 across and every 40.0 mm to 297.7, all 22.0 down; the two push buttons centre at 331.0 across, 15.0 and 30.0 down; the inlet centre at 403.0 across, 22.0 down. The turn of each outlet (270) and the inlet's (none: the library's part as it is) is ESTIMATED: the photograph shows the faces too small to settle which way each is turned, and the data sheet does not say (gaps: orientation).

input.note: datasheet - "Connector 1 IEC C20 (250V AC, 16A)", "C20 Power Cord Input", "Input Voltage 110V-240V AC", "Regulatory Derated Input Current (North America) 16A", "Maximum Total Current 20A", "Load cap. @ 120V/16A (1920VA) Load cap. @240V/20A (4800VA)". The sheet's own text calls the included cord both "C19 to NEMA5-20p" and the unit's input a C20; the inlet is a C20. The photograph shows the inlet at the right end of the front.

method.note: ESTIMATED. NO DIMENSIONED DRAWING AND NO STRAIGHT-ON PICTURE EXISTS. Every position is read off the one product photograph on page 1 of the PDU08C13H data sheet (a 400 x 400 pixel image, taken from the front left and above), so it is NOT orthographic: x is read as a fraction of the ear-to-ear length along the face (ear tips at 20 and 348 px, 484 mm) and corrected by eye for perspective, which spreads the nearer, right-hand side; y is read at the face's own scale. The outlets sit on a near-constant pitch, which supports one pitch across the row, but the two push buttons and the inlet lie in the stretched part of the view, and every position is good to about 10 mm across and 3 mm down.

outlets.note: datasheet - data sheet, page 1 and 2: "8 POWERFUL NEMA C13 OUTLETS", "Number of Power Outlets 8", "Connector 2 (Quantity) 8, IEC C13 Receptacle (250V AC, 10A)". The photograph shows all eight on the front; the data sheet does not say which face. The outlets are std/c13-outlet@1's size.
